feeds.title: Black Enterprise
feeds.description: Since 1970, Black Enterprise has been the go-to resource for black entrepreneurs and professionals. It offers indispensable business insights, career advice, and tech and finance content, empowering black individuals to thrive in the corporate world and beyond.

feeds.title: Black On The Job Blog
feeds.description: Black On The Job, a visionary career development company, is dedicated to propelling Black professionals to six-figure success. Recognizing historical disparities, they offer affordable services to empower advancement in corporate America and globally. From resume services to career coaching, they equip individuals to surpass middle-class status with tailored support.

feeds.title: Twanna Carter Blog
feeds.description: Twanna Carter is a dedicated ally for career success and work-life harmony, offering transformative guidance for Black women. Her EmpowHer Insights blog features empowering articles and invaluable advice, equipping individuals to shatter glass ceilings and achieve their career aspirations.

feeds.title: Justblackthoughts.com » Career & Jobs
feeds.description: JustBlackThoughts.com is a comprehensive hub for career and job-related content, tailored for African-American males. It addresses critical questions like financial stability for teachers and the representation of Black male educators in the US education system. With insightful career advice and data-driven analysis, it aims to empower and inform its audience.

feeds.title: BlackNews.com » Business & Career
feeds.description: BlackNews.com has been a trusted source since 2000 for African American news, commentary, and celebrity updates. It serves as a non-partisan online destination, providing valuable insights into developments related to Black business owners, entrepreneurs, and professionals.

feeds.title: Black Professionals Network Blog
feeds.description: Black Professionals Network (BPN) empowers 1 million Black professionals toward greater earning potential and enduring legacies. Offering a resource-rich network, BPN advances careers, businesses, and households, fostering collaboration under the motto 'together, each achieves more.'

feeds.title: Black Career Women's Network Blog
feeds.description: Black Career Women's Network (BCWN), a premier national organization, empowers black career women through professional development since 2012. Their Career Advice Blog serves as a beacon of guidance, fostering growth and support in the workplace.

feeds.title: Balanced Black Girl » Career
feeds.description: Balanced Black Girl is a vibrant online platform championing women of colour in wellness. They guide seekers toward holistic well-being, fostering lasting habits and joyful living. Embracing emotional, physical, social, and spiritual facets, they redefine balance and happiness for all.

feeds.title: BYP Network Blog
feeds.description: BYP Network, founded in 2016 by Kike Oniwinde Agoro, connects Black professionals globally for career growth and mentorship. With Javelin, their platform, they aim to advance millions of careers by facilitating connections, job opportunities, and access to thought leadership.
